desc: Implement the median transformed-position solution in Python.
Read N and S, and collect the 0-based positions of all characters equal to '1'.
Transform each one-position p_i into p_i - i, where i is the 0-based rank among the ones.
Select the median transformed value and compute the total cost as the sum of absolute differences.
Ensure the implementation runs efficiently for N up to 5e5 and uses Python integer arithmetic for large answers.
Validate edge cases: single '1', all '1's, already contiguous '1's, leading/trailing zeros, and even number of '1's.
